from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import SPSA
from qiskit.optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit.providers.aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit.circuit.library import GroverOperator
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, Aer
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram
from qiskit.utils import QuantumInstance
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuboToQuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization import OptimizationResult
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager
from qiskit.transpiler.passes import Unroller
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np

def solve_sensor_cluster_partition():
    # Define the graph
    graph_vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    graph_edges = [
        [0, 1, 2],
        [1, 2, 2],
        [0, 2, 2],
        [3, 4, 2],
        [4, 5, 2],
        [3, 5, 2],
        [0, 3, 8],
        [1, 4, 7],
        [2, 5, 6]
    ]

    # Create an undirected graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Convert the graph to a QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo_obj = qubo.convert(G)

    # Create an optimization problem
    optimization_problem = QuadraticProgram()
    optimization_problem.from_docplex_model(qubo_obj)

    # Define the objective function as Maximize
    optimization_problem.objective.sense = "maximize"

    # Define the QAOA parameters
    qaoa_params = {
        "p": 10,
        "max_iterations": 100,
        "initial_point": np.random.rand(qaoa_params["p"] * 2),
        "solver": SPSA(maxiter=qaoa_params["max_iterations"]),
        "max_evals_grouped": 2,
    }

    # Set up the QAOA workflow
    qaoa = QAOA(
        optimization_problem=optimization_problem,
        reps=qaoa_params["p"],
        initial_point=qaoa_params["initial_point"],
        optimizer=qaoa_params["solver"],
        max_evals_grouped=qaoa_params["max_evals_grouped"],
    )

    # Execute the QAOA workflow
    optimization_result = qaoa.run(
        quantum_instance=AerSimulator(),
        initial_point=qaoa_params["initial_point"],
    )

    # Get the solution
    solution = optimization_result.x

    # Calculate the objective value
    objective_value = optimization_problem.objective.evaluate(solution)

    # Calculate the approximation ratio
    cut_value = nx.maximum_cut(G, weight='weight').value()
    approximation_ratio = objective_value / cut_value

    # Calculate the success probability
    success_probability = qaoa.options.max_evals_grouped * qaoa.options.max_evals_grouped / (qaoa.options.max_evals_grouped + 1)

    # Calculate the circuit depth
    circuit_depth = qaoa.get_circuit().depth()

    # Calculate the two-qubit gate count
    two_qubit_gate_count = qaoa.get_circuit().count_ops().get("cx", 0)

    # Calculate the number of shots
    shots = 1000

    # Calculate the number of optimizer calls
    optimizer_calls = qaoa.options.max_evals_grouped

    return {
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "success_probability": success_probability,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": two_qubit_gate_count,
        "shots": shots,
        "optimizer_calls": optimizer_calls,
        "cut_value": cut_value
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = solve_sensor_cluster_partition()
    print(result)
